slides.title: Ops standards
bullets: Naming follows division + product + variant conventions.
Copy must be customer-safe and legally cautious.
QA includes links, images, and mobile preview.

lesson.objective: Apply naming, copy, collection, QA, and access standards for apparel operations.
lesson.why_it_matters: Standards keep multi-contributor catalog work reviewable and reversible.
lesson.apply: Audit one live listing against the ops rubric in this episode.
